sampling.temperatureHint: Controls randomness. Lower = more deterministic, higher = more creative (0–2).
sampling.topPHint: Nucleus sampling: only tokens within top P cumulative probability are considered (0–1).
sampling.frequencyPenaltyHint: Penalizes tokens by how often they've appeared so far (−2 to 2).
sampling.presencePenaltyHint: Penalizes tokens that have appeared at all, encouraging new topics (−2 to 2).
sampling.topKHint: Limits sampling to top K tokens. Supported by Ollama and some providers (1–200).
sampling.minPHint: Minimum probability threshold relative to the top token. Ollama-specific (0–1).
sampling.numCtxHint: Max tokens in the context window. Ollama defaults to 2048 — set higher (e.g. 16384) to avoid truncating large inputs. Ollama-specific.
sampling.numPredictHint: Maximum tokens to generate. Use -1 for unlimited. Ollama-specific.
